checkedAlternates.risk: TXT records are heavily used for SPF/DKIM email authentication.
checkedAlternates.resolution: TXT is a general-purpose text metadata record (group-4), whereas MX specifically routes mail (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: CNAME eventually resolves to an IP address.
checkedAlternates.resolution: CNAME maps a hostname to another canonical hostname (group-4), not directly to an IP.
